description: Full deep research pipeline: search the web, fetch pages, extract claims, build evidence graph, and generate a structured answer with citations and confidence score. Use depth='thorough' for auto-retry with rephrased queries when confidence is low. Use depth='deep' for multi-step agentic research that identifies knowledge gaps and runs follow-up searches. On thorough/deep, every cited URL is probed for liveness: each source carries a urlHealth field (live | stale | dead | unchecked) and the result includes a citationHealth summary, so you can trust that citations resolve and detect fabricated links. Every fetched page is also scanned for hidden / non-rendered content (where most real-world prompt injections live) before extraction: hidden content is stripped, instruction-shaped text is counted, and each source carries an integrity signal plus a result-level contentRisk summary — a signal for your policy layer, not a guarantee. Instruction-directed spans are redacted from page text before extraction; pass strict=true to drop high-risk sources entirely. Every stored result has a signed evidence record — call the evidence tool with the result's shareId. Enterprise: use searchProvider to search internal data instead of the public web. DISCLAIMER: Results are AI-generated for informational purposes only — not financial, medical, or legal advice. Confidence scores are algorithmic estimates, not accuracy guarantees. Always verify critical information from primary sources.

depth.description: Research depth: 'fast' (default), 'thorough' (auto-retry if confidence < 60%), or 'deep' (multi-step agentic research with gap analysis)

searchProvider.description: Enterprise: configure a custom search backend instead of public web search

endpoint.description: Endpoint URL (required for elasticsearch, confluence, custom)

strict.description: Exclude sources whose content-integrity risk is 'high' (hidden instruction-shaped text) from extraction entirely

name: answer
